orbit-ssh-server-monitor.description:
Secure, offline SSH client & SFTP manager. Monitor Linux servers natively.

Orbit is an advanced, offline-first SSH and SFTP server management hub designed strictly for developers, system administrators, and technology professionals. Built to transform your mobile device into a high-performance terminal, Orbit allows you to monitor health metrics, execute commands, and manage files on your Linux servers—without relying on centralized proxies or developer infrastructure.
